title: Objection
description: Adversarial critique from ag-commitment-critic blocking an unfulfillable or unprofitable promise.

condition_id.description: Specific gate condition violated (e.g. COND_01_CARRIER_CUTOFF, COND_02_ATP_SAFETY_STOCK, COND_05_MARGIN_FLOOR)

summary.description: Concise summary of the blocking issue

detail.description: Detailed explanation with numerical delta (e.g. carrier cutoff missed by 6 hours)

blocking.description: If true, blocks commitment and triggers ag-substitution-strategist

suggested_resolution.description: Mandatory remediation action (e.g. substitute with SKU-9042 from DC-WEST or shift delivery window by +1 day)

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the input payload or computation_id that triggered the objection
